# API reference

Public Lua API **1.0.0**, native ABI **1**, framework **0.1.3**.

[Events](events.md) | [Types](types.md) | [Capabilities](capabilities.md) | [Native ABI](native.md) | [Manifests](manifests.md)

## actions

- [`mt2.actions.place`](functions/actions-place.md): Queue a checked native building placement.
- [`mt2.actions.move`](functions/actions-move.md): Queue a checked native move.
- [`mt2.actions.remove`](functions/actions-remove.md): Queue a checked native removal.
- [`mt2.actions.status`](functions/actions-status.md): Read accepted, confirmed, rejected or unknown status.

## camera

- [`mt2.camera.get`](functions/camera-get.md): Read camera position, focus and edit state.
- [`mt2.camera.focus`](functions/camera-focus.md): Request the native edit camera to focus a position.

## config

- [`mt2.config.define`](functions/config-define.md): Define a typed setting shown in the Mods menu.
- [`mt2.config.get`](functions/config-get.md): Read a defined setting.
- [`mt2.config.set`](functions/config-set.md): Validate and save a setting.

## content

- [`mt2.content.register`](functions/content-register.md): Register static scenery resources at startup.

## events

- [`mt2.events.on`](functions/events-on.md): Subscribe to an event.
- [`mt2.events.off`](functions/events-off.md): Remove your subscription.

## input

- [`mt2.input.bind`](functions/input-bind.md): Bind an owned keyboard shortcut.

## log

- [`mt2.log.debug`](functions/log-debug.md): Write a mod-labelled debug log entry.
- [`mt2.log.info`](functions/log-info.md): Write a mod-labelled info log entry.
- [`mt2.log.warn`](functions/log-warn.md): Write a mod-labelled warn log entry.
- [`mt2.log.error`](functions/log-error.md): Write a mod-labelled error log entry.

## objects

- [`mt2.objects.list`](functions/objects-list.md): Read a bounded list of supported props.
- [`mt2.objects.get`](functions/objects-get.md): Read a supported object.
- [`mt2.objects.selected`](functions/objects-selected.md): Read the first supported selected object, or nil.
- [`mt2.objects.persist`](functions/objects-persist.md): Create a mod-owned persistent building reference.
- [`mt2.objects.resolve`](functions/objects-resolve.md): Resolve a saved reference to a fresh session handle.

## storage

- [`mt2.storage.get`](functions/storage-get.md): Read mod-owned profile or world data.
- [`mt2.storage.set`](functions/storage-set.md): Store mod-owned profile or world data.

## time

- [`mt2.time.get`](functions/time-get.md): Read pause, simulation speed and clock.
- [`mt2.time.set`](functions/time-set.md): Set pause and speed, then read them back.

## ui

- [`mt2.ui.window`](functions/ui-window.md): Register a window once and draw its contents on render.
- [`mt2.ui.text`](functions/ui-text.md): Draw text in the current window.
- [`mt2.ui.button`](functions/ui-button.md): Draw a button; true on the frame it is pressed.
- [`mt2.ui.checkbox`](functions/ui-checkbox.md): Draw a checkbox and return its current value.
- [`mt2.ui.number`](functions/ui-number.md): Draw a numeric slider and return its value.

## world

- [`mt2.world.status`](functions/world-status.md): Read the loaded world name and current epoch.
